title: Everllence 175D engines picked to power state-of-the-art live fish carrier
summary: Everllence has signed a contract with the Astilleros Zamakona shipyard in Bilbao, Spain to supply four 12V175D-MEV variable-speed generator sets (each developing 2,040kW @ 1800 rpm) for a 5,000-cubic-meter live-fish…
